title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/MANUAL WINDOW CRANKS (8/82) (117 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES COULD HAVE A LATCH WHICH SCRAPES AN ALUMINUM TRIM PIECE INCREASING THE FORCE REQUIRED TO OPEN. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY (224,642 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.  THE CENTER REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY NOT BE ACCESSIBLE WHEN THE RIGHT (PASSENGER) SIDE OF THE REAR SEAT BACK IS FOLDED DOWN IN THE CARGO STOWAGE POSITION.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AUTO TRANSM. COOLER LINES (5,220 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   THE TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER HOSE ASSEMBY CAN RUPTURE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER (28,068 affected)
summary: THE INSTRUMENT PANEL CLUSTER TRIM PLATE/BEZEL CAN SAG AND COVER THE LIGHT EMITTING DIODE PORTION (LIGHTED POINTED ABOVE PANEL) OF THE TRANSAXLE SHIFT INDICATOR DISPLAY. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 101, "CONTROL LOCATION, IDENTIFICATION, AND ILLUMINATION."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/STEERING:COLUMN SHAFT UPPER (3,047 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN UPPER INTERMEDIATE-SHAFT NUT MAY NOT BE TORQUED TO PROPER SPECIFICATIONS. THE NUT COULD LOOSEN AND DETACH ALLOWING THE THROUGH-BOLT THAT SECURES THE UPPER INTERMEDIATE-SHAFT TO THE LOWER STEERING COLUMN SHAFT JOINT TO FALL OUT.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (10,423 affected)
summary: DUE TO A PRINTING ERROR, THE FOLD-OUT INSTRUCTION PAMPHLET PROVIDING INFORMATION ON TODDLER USE WAS INCORRECTLY LABELED FOR INFANT USE.

title: ROSTRA PRECISION CONTROLS, INC.: ROSTRA/FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (5,145 affected)
summary: THESE CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEMS FAIL TO HOLD THE SPEED SET BY THE DRIVER AND CAN ACCELERATE ABOVE THE INTENDED SET SPEED.

title: PEUGEOT, INC.: PEUGEOT/FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (3,561 affected)
summary: THE CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE FUEL TANK MOUNTING DETERIORATES ALLOWING WATER AND FOREIGN MATERIAL TO CORRODE THE TANK MOUNTING FLANGE DIRECTLY.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR/MUFFLER:RESONATOR (21 affected)
summary: THESE HEAVY TRUCKS WERE EQUIPPED WITH EXHAUST MUFFLERS WITHOUT HEAT SHIELDING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/ENGINE (40,000 affected)
summary: IN CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD OIL GALLEY PLUG DOES NOT SEAL PROPERLY AND ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD OIL IS NOT ADEQUATELY RETAINED.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES/STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (44,114 affected)
summary: IN A MINOR FRONTAL IMPACT, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE HOOD LATCH HOOK TO BE DAMAGED AND NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY AS A SECONDARY SAFETY CATCH. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 113, "HOOD LATCH SYSTEMS."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AIR CONDITIONER:CLIMATE CONTROL MODULE (10,600 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE CLIMATE CONTROL BLOWER DOES NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED. THE BLOWER COULD (1) STICK ON "HIGH;" (2) OPERATE ERRATICALLY WITH BLOWER OUTPUT VARYING BETWEEN NO BLOWER AND MAXIMUM BLOWER; OR (3) NOT OPERATE AT ALL DUE TO MALFUNCTION OF THE TEMPERATURE CONTROL MODULE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (265,000 affected)
summary: A STATIC ELECTRIC CHARGE CAN BUILD UP ON THE UNGROUNDED METAL SECTION OF THE FUEL FILLER TUBE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (108 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE COOLING FAN ASSEMBLIES CAN BREAK FROM FATIGUE CAUSED BY ENGINE AND/OR VEHICLE INDUCED STRESSES.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/STEERING:GEAR:RACK (88 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE LEFT STEERING RACK MOUNTING SUPPORTS WERE IMPROPERLY HEAT TREATED RESULTING IN THE POSSIBLE FRACTURING OF THE SUPPORT.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SAAB/STEERING:COLUMN (8,988 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN SHAFT WAS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED IN THE VEHICLE CAUSING THE COLUMN TO BE OUT OF ALIGNMENT.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (358 affected)
summary: INTERMITTENT DISRUPTION OF THE FUNCTIONS CONTROLLED BY THE STEERING WHEEL CENTER TOUCH PAD CAN OCCUR CAUSED BY ELECTRICAL SHORTAGE INSIDE THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY.  THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 104, "WINDHSIELD WIPING AND WASHING SYSTEMS;" AND NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/LIGHTING AND COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEMS (40,000 affected)
summary: A DEFECTIVE CONTROL MODULE IN THE "AUTOLAMP" SYSTEM CAN MALFUNCTION. IF THE "AUTOLAMP" SYSTEM IS BEING USED TO ACTIVATE THE EXTERIOR LIGHT (INCLUDING HEADLAMPS), THE HEADLAMPS COULD SHUT OFF WITHOUT WARNING. THIS WILL NOT OCCUR IF THE EXTERIOR LIGHTING IS TURNED ON MANUALLY BY THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA (307 affected)
summary: THE WRONG CIRCUIT BREAKER WAS INSTALLED IN THE ELECTRICAL PANEL WHICH COULD CAUSE AN INTERRUPTION OF THE 8-LIGHT WARNING SYSTEM.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/HANDRAILS (327 affected)
summary: THESE BUSES ARE EQUIPPED WITH AN ENTRANCE DOOR HANDRAIL OFF SET BRACE ATTACHED TO THE INTERIOR WALL AND THE HANDRAIL. THE ATTACHMENT POINT AT THE WALL IS INCORRECTLY POSITIONED PERMITTING THE ENTRAPMENT OF THE "CONNECTICUT NUT/STRING TEST DEVICE" BETWEEN THE UPPER EDGE OF THE BRACE AND THE LOWER EDGE OF THE SEAT LEDGE. PASSENGER'S CLOTHING COULD UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT THE BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT (585,182 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES MANUFACTURED FROM AUGUST 1991 THROUGH JULY 1995.  THE TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER  LINE CAN SEPARATE WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN LOW TEMPERATURES IN COMBINATION WITH HIGH TRANSMISSION LOADS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/COMMUNICATIONS:HORN ASSEMBLY (417,000 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.  THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH INSUFFICIENT RETENTION OF THE HORN PAD.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SWITCH:BRAKE WARNING (76,500 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE SYSTEM FLUID LEVEL INDICATOR LAMP SWITCH CAN MALFUNCTION. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/BRAKES:AIR:CHAMBER (730 affected)
summary: CONTACT BETWEEN THE BRAKE CHAMBER AND THE SUSPENSION BEAM CAN RESULT IN DAMAGE TO THE BRAKE CHAMBER CLAMP BAND.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: VW/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH (24,000 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE IGNITION SWITCHES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED AND CAN CAUSE SOME ELECTRICAL ACCESSORIES TO MALFUNCTION.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/LOWER CONTROL ARM (102,403 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT ATTACHMENT NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED AND CAN LOOSEN.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/LOWER CONTROL ARM/PUERTO RICO ONLY (308 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT ATTACHMENT NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED AND CAN LOOSEN.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:CONTROL ARM (154,214 affected)
summary: THE REAR LOWER CONTROL ARM CAN CRACK AT THE REAR STABILIZER BAR ATTACHMENT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK HYDRAULIC CYLINDER (1,029,380 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTI-PURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.  THE CAMPAIGN WILL REINFORCE THE BRACKET ATTACHMENTS OF THE REAR LIFTGATE GAS ASSIST CYLINDERS WHICH COULD PULL AWAY FROM THE INSIDE OF THE LIFTGATE.
